fix(duckdb): append on 1-based ARRAY_INSERT -1 (#8597)

Summary:
Spark/Databricks ARRAY_INSERT with 1-based position -1 appends after the
last element, but the DuckDB helper normalized -1 to 0 and emitted a
prepend (LIST_CONCAT([elem], arr)). Detect index_offset == 1 and pos == -1
before normalization and emit LIST_CONCAT(arr, [elem]) with the same
NULL-propagating CASE WHEN as the other branches. Snowflake/0-based -1,
positive positions, -2 and below, and non-literal positions are unchanged.

on clean main. Transpile probes confirm Spark/Databricks -1 now appends and
Snowflake -1 / Spark -2 / non-literal output is unchanged.
